title: Home Assistant access vector
description: Which Home Assistant access fields client_config carries for a device (tools/profiles_ref.py ha_access): a bare member profile with the given control_path and remote_access, resolved on the platform, with the access open or closed. tools/validate.py recomputes every case.

control_path.description: Profile value of the rule control_path.

remote_access.description: Profile value of the rule remote_access.

access_open.description: The device's access is open now (access hours, access switch, guest expiry).

phone_watch.description: Watches only: the phone's effective rule watch is on at the same moment (ha_access phone). A watch holds no key without it.

control_path.description: Effective value (hub is checked on tvos, android_tv, watchos and wearos).

holds_key.description: The device gets its own Home Assistant key (holds_key; a watch only while its phone's rule watch is on).

hub_path.description: The device reads and switches through the hub where it is reachable (a watch or a TV never).

token.description: How client_config carries the device's Home Assistant token (ha_token): clear = in client_config, sealed = only inside watch_access (watches), null = not at all.

kids_away.description: client_config.kids.away; null = no kids block (no parental controls).
